changes.text: John Houston - Mission 4b, Riots in Talos: Alexander Pavlidis' guards are no longer friendly and passive, and can be defeated to complete the objective of freeing Alexander. Mission completion now only requires a player to reach the exit, and no longer requires Alexander to reach the exit.
Corrected damage type of Hero Corps Little League's Line Drive power.
Updates to pedestrian pathing in Port Oakes and Founders Falls.
